invalid_transition_behavior: Throw VNextStateTransitionDeniedError; STOP has no outbound transition.
recovery_semantics: FREEZE→READY only for explicitly recoverable reason and OWNER/SYSTEM actor allowed by freeze-reason catalog.
audit_event_semantics: DOC-C requires every state transition traceable; PipelineRun persistence emits FSM_TRANSITION events separately.
alignment_notes: Event 'cancel' exists in VNEXT_EVENT and is OWNER-owned, but no cancel transition row exists in observed VNEXT_TRANSITIONS; review before treating cancel as executable FSM event.
